output.methods: Instrumented twelve open-source pipelines and re-executed each in a fresh environment.
output.population_or_dataset: twelve open-source Python data science pipelines
output.results: 8 of 12 pipelines changed outputs; recording versions restored 7 of those 8.

passages.quote: In this fixture, eight of the twelve pipelines produced different outputs when re-executed with updated library versions.
passages.summary: Most pipelines changed outputs after updates.

passages.quote: Recording library versions allowed seven of those eight pipelines to be restored to their original outputs.
The study covered only Python pipelines, and the selection of pipelines was not random.
All pipelines became fully reproducible after applying our tool.

claims.proposition: Recording library versions restored most pipelines whose outputs changed after re-execution.
